raw_ocr_excerpt:
*Dear Student*,

We are thrilled to extend our heartfelt congratulations on your selection
into Blend Vidya's Internship Program! This is a unique chance for you to
embark on a transformative journey towards personal and professional growth.

*Program Details:*

*Choose Your Interest*:

a). Full Stack Web Development

b). Python

c). Digital Marketing

d). Artificial Intelligence (AI)

*Internship Highlights:*

*Hands-on Freelance Projects:* Work on real projects for esteemed companies
and earn an attractive stipend ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per project.
Gain valuable real-world experience and enhance your skill set.

*12-Week Program, Dual Phases:* Your journey spans 12 weeks, featuring
Training and Project Phases, commencing on December 5th. Sharpen your
skills, dive into exciting projects, and experience the practical
applications of your learning.

*Certifications:*

Training Completion Certificate

Internship Completion Certificate

*Opportunities Await:*

Upon successful completion, shortlisted candidates will receive valuable
freelancing opportunities. Earn ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 for each project, and
proudly showcase your Training and Internship Completion Certificates.

*Program Duration:*

January 5th - April 5th
